RCC/central_only.label: sensitivity, cancer/normal classes only
RCC/central_only.caption: sensitivity, cancer/normal classes only: the reference sets, mSCF1, F1 ceilings, P1 reference groups and the supervised oracle all use the cancer and normal PCCs only; rankings and K_bin as the primary
disclosures: unannotated class, 45-78% of pixels; the dataset's own Cardinal workflow treats these pixels as background (rcc_nobg), but this was not independently verified
GMM K = 3 equals the number of label classes: label-free in training and ranking, class-informed in its component count
legacy msiPL not run on RCC (requires count tuning)
limitations: per the dataset documentation, UH0505_12 and UH9905_18 contain heterogeneous tumour with large normal-looking areas (descriptive; no exclusion, no separate analysis)
RCC/central_only.budget_note: K_bin = released S3PL target num_GT_peaks (~|R@0.5|, the paper's RCC threshold), the GBM/CAC convention: 466-2,200 bins per run; GBM K_bin 584-1,028 and CAC K_bin 133-315 bins
RCC/central_only.p1_note: P1 on RCC is singleton groups, so its peak-level score is the bin-level score at the K_peak budget (~|R@0.4|); it is a budget sensitivity, not an independent partition check; it does not enter the verdict
